text: Neurology is a clinical medical discipline that studies the etiology, pathology, diagnosis, treatment and prevention of diseases of the nervous system (including the brain, spinal cord, peripheral nerves and muscles), and it is both theoretical and practical. The training objective is: Through systematic study of neuroanatomy, pathophysiology, clinical diagnosis and treatment techniques, students will master the diagnostic and therapeutic thinking of neurological diseases, possess the ability to independently handle common neurological diseases (such as stroke, epilepsy, Parkinson's disease), and be able to explore cutting-edge fields such as neurodegenerative diseases and nerve injury repair in scientific research.
